description.text: Educational Objectives This program prepares undergraduates with an extensive and solid background in flight vehicle systems, structure, aerodynamics, and guidance and control. Students will have expertise in the system analysis, overall design, and parametric designof flight vehicle systems. Program Outcomes The undergraduates are qualified to work in areas related with aeronautics and astronautics science and technology, such as aircraft design, flight vehicle guidance and control, flight dynamics, structure analysis and design, aerodynamic characteristics analysis and the design of aircraft. The future major employers could be industrial enterprises, research institutes, and other companies related to theoretical research, experimental research, technology development and technology management in the areas of aeronautics and astronautics science and technology. Duration and Degree 4 years, Bachelor Degree in Engineering

duration.text: The Flight Vehicle Design and Engineering at Beijing Institute of Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4250 USD/per year ￥ 30600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3. High school academic transcript 4. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. A notarization of guarantor in China Only for applicants under 18 years old. 7. Financial support statement Photocopy of the financial support statement with signature

requirements.text: 1.High school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate; 2.Good command of mathematics 3.Efficient English language skills (TOEFL 550 or IELTS 5.5) 4.Under age 35 Note: Native English speakers or graduates from high schools where English is an official teaching language are exempt from TOEFL and IELTS scores.
